name: La Libellule Mécanique
source: La Libellule Mécanique is a steam-punk otome game. Céleste, the protagonist, is searching for her father, the inventor of the Libellule Mécanique. He was taken in the city of Koréare, an underground city populated by people banished from the upper city, by an organisation that wants to use the Libellule Mécanique to conquer the upper world.
translation: 《机械蜻蜓》是一款蒸汽朋克风格的乙女游戏。主人公塞莱斯特正在寻找父亲，他是“机械蜻蜓”的发明者。父亲在科雷亚尔城被一个组织掳走。那里是一座地下城市，居民都是被上层城市放逐的人，而这个组织想利用机械蜻蜓征服地上世界。
